title: The Melody Found in a Mistake
short_teaser: Musicians sometimes keep an unexpected note, rhythm, or technical error because it creates a better direction.
story: Musicians sometimes keep an unexpected note, rhythm, or technical error because it creates a better direction. A mistake becomes creative material when curiosity replaces embarrassment. Creativity grows through attention, experimentation, revision, and the courage to make an imperfect beginning. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
